checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Pinned historical releases, runtime contracts, strict weight loads and fixed-panel comparator check.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No weight crosses dataset boundaries. LoRa exact R69 weight is unavailable under this source contract; native R17 is the current matched DURA family comparator in the screen. A like-for-like two-stage LoRa DURA adaptation is still needed before final acceptance.
checkpoint.selection_rule: New 160 physical V packets per dataset on predetermined receiver, same paired test and bootstrap as previous. Each experimental readout individually requires at least +8 low-urban correct and positive lower 95% bound versus each of the original three controls, and Clean at least matches their maximum. Only then consider preregistered full target verification.

execution.launch_owner: Current LoRa performance chat, dual dataset objective
execution.gpu_policy: Read actual N607 slots. [5,2,6,3,0,7], at least 12288 MiB and fewer than eight contexts. One worker per card, at most two; serialize if one.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent stages on exact ancestor, disjoint fixed source IDs, actual-checkpoint smoke, finite output or paired prediction closure failures. No formal action for any failing row.

notes: Test whether the companion proposal or the DURA likelihood update is responsible for the observed loss. The fused control is the prior complete method. Data-only sets the companion residual to zero, while keeping the two constrained CG steps and regularizer. Companion-only turns off the likelihood and uses the exact minimizer of that same prior alone.

All paths retain the same primary waveform, linear complex projection and raw correction norm cap 25%. LoRa primary is the fixed real-gain waveform, WiSig is original R69. This source source V comparison uses no new parameter updates and only clean and registered Full low urban.
Disjoint from earlier 192 screening packets by exact read-only frozen IDs. LoRa also excludes the earlier 300 V. WiSig known archive exposure is retained. Full target remains unchanged and unread.
